gift.i1n: A place for a free gift
gift.i1t: A component marked as a free gift ships in the parcel at the bundle price. It comes off stock like any component and counts toward cost. How the gift appears on the document is a separate decision, by default as in settings.
gift.summary: ships in the parcel, costs you
gift.title: Free gifts in a bundle

guide.lede: A bundle is a product with components. Here is how OpenLinker works out its stock, price and composition.

offer.i1t: On a marketplace you list a bundle like any product. A bundle does not need its own EAN, because its products have the codes. If a component cannot be listed, the wizard shows it on the bundle and suggests what to do.
offer.title: Bundle offers

guide.title: How bundles work

ver.i1n: Open orders keep the old composition
ver.i1t: A change applies to orders placed after you save. Orders already placed ship with the composition of the day they were placed. You can see earlier versions in the bundle history.
ver.title: Changing the composition

what.i1t: A bundle is an ordinary product in your shop that OpenLinker breaks into components. The customer buys one line and the packer gets the list of things to put in the parcel.
what.i2t: A bundle has one price, the same as in your shop. The order, the document and the channel keep that price. You only see the price split across components for information.
what.title: What a bundle is
